note: Numeric decision rules fixed before any PCBA arm finished its 25-epoch prefix (at freeze time PCBA SREN-ADD was at epoch 3/25; no small-dataset arm had finished). Applied mechanically by code/esr_collect.py.

best_explicit.statistic: best Validation AP inside the 25-epoch prefix
best_explicit.tie_rule: if the top two are within 0.001 AP, prefer the earlier entry of [SREN-ADD, SREN-EVID, SREN-BANK, SREN-COMPOUND]

triggers.D2_extension_40: L1 and curve still improving: argmax epoch >= 20 and mean(AP epochs 21..25) > mean(AP epochs 16..20); pairs EVID->ADD, BANK->HIDDEN, COMPOUND->BANK, ADD->HIDDEN
triggers.D3_BANK_FLEX: HIDDEN >= best_explicit + 0.005 and HIDDEN satisfies L1
triggers.D5_RANGE4: L1 and wall clock and GPU budget allow after D1-D4 (lowest priority, cancelled first)

small_data_signals.LIPO: BASE_valid_rmse * 0.98 (>=2% relative RMSE reduction) for at least one explicit arm
small_data_signals.TOX21: BASE_macro_roc_auc + 0.005 for at least one explicit arm

honesty_rules: no Test number influences any decision
no arm, width, epoch or promotion rule changes after this file is committed
a level that is not reached is reported as not reached
